questions.cardText:
[Zoology] What is the shape of wombat poop?
A. Cubic
B. Spherical
C. Cylindrical
Answer: A. This unusual shape is due to the special structure of their intestines. This adaptation has been theorized to help wombats mark their territory effectively, as the cubes are less likely to roll away from where they are deposited.
questions.de: Welche Form hat der Kot von Wombats?

timeline.labelEn: Researchers explain how wombat intestines form cube-shaped faeces
timeline.labelDe: Forscher erklären, wie der Darm von Wombats würfelförmigen Kot formt

questions.notes: Card correct: Wikipedia — wombats leave distinctive cube-shaped faeces, thought to be less likely to roll when used to mark territory.

questions.cardText:
[Chemistry] Which of the following elements was discovered by Marie Curie?
A. Polonium
B. Thorium
C. Uranium
Answer: A. Marie Curie named the element polonium after her homeland, Poland, which at the time of the discovery was not an independent nation.
questions.de: Welches Element benannte Marie Curie nach ihrer Heimat, die damals kein unabhängiger Staat war?
questions.en: Which element did Marie Curie name after her homeland, which was not an independent country at the time?

timeline.labelEn: Marie and Pierre Curie announce the discovery of polonium in pitchblende
timeline.labelDe: Marie und Pierre Curie geben die Entdeckung des Poloniums in Pechblende bekannt

questions.notes: Card correct (with Pierre Curie, July 1898). Reworded around the naming, since the Curies also discovered radium.
